scripts/error_catalog_powershell.ps1

PowerShell · Tier B

Project canonical launcher diagnostics through the installed Python catalog.

Usage

Dot-source this helper and pass a stable reference to Get-SMTOError.

Inputs

A catalog reference; Python is selected from the Gateway environment or PATH.

Side effects

Returns safe diagnostic text; restores PYTHONPATH and the native exit code.

Cleanup

Does not install, activate, launch services, retry work or change settings.

@see src/error_catalog/main.py
